# RVAClassic public brand core

Open `index.html` for the download page and `brand-guide/index.html` for the guide. All links are relative and work when hosted as a folder. Includes true vector logos and wordmarks, PNGs, favicons, tokens, supporting elements, fonts/licenses, and the HTML/PDF guide. Full wallpapers and campaign content are delivered in the separate launch package.

The ZIP link expects `RVAClassic-Brand-Core.zip` beside this index. A copy is placed there by the packaging step. The ZIP itself excludes its own archive copy.
